lines.text: Many learners say: I sit the bus to school.
Better: I take the bus to school.
Take! I take the bus to school.

data.wrong: I sit the bus to school.
data.right: I take the bus to school.

native.hook: 坐公交要说 take the bus！
native.tip: 中文说“坐公交”，所以很多人直译成 sit the bus。英语里坐公交要说 take the bus。
native.caption: 你是不是也会说 “I sit the bus to school.”😅 中文说“坐公交”，但英语里要说 take：“I take the bus to school.”跟着 Ama 老师读一读！在 Lexkite 应用里练习更多。
native.comment: 答案：“I take the bus to school.”大声读一遍，再写一句你自己的句子。免费测验在这里：{link}

en.tip: In Chinese, you “sit” a bus, so many learners say “sit the bus.” English says “take the bus.”
en.caption: Do you say “I sit the bus to school.” 😅 In English, you take a bus: “I take the bus to school.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
